name: Landscape Image
summary: Prompt pack and review contract for project background and landscape image generation.

license_policy.notes: Generated outputs require project-level review before publication.

prompt_pack.system: Generate a clean project-ready landscape or background asset with consistent lighting, no text, and clear foreground-safe composition.
prompt_pack.negative: Avoid watermarks, text, UI elements, distorted perspective, unreadable clutter, and inconsistent scale.
